faqs.question: What is the scope of MBA?
faqs.answer:
The scope of MBA course is increasing day by day. MBA is one of the big job oriented professional programme and the most one which has been sought by the students. Once you have completed your degree, you have a great job opportunity in the industrial world. You may the manager or executive in term of designation.
The management term is most suited to the managers and that's why it is the way, where you can reach on the top of the height as soon as possible by using your leadership and working proficiency. An MBA professional always plays a vital role in his/her company and this is why he used to keep in touch with the board of directors. No need to specify the companies who recruit the MBA professionals. faqs.question: Is the BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus the same for all colleges?
faqs.answer: The BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus is not the same across all colleges, as every college committee sets a particular coursework pattern at the start of every academic year to be followed for the respective batch. The syllabus includes some core subjects, interesting electives, and lab work that gives detailed knowledge to the students about the workings of the field.

faqs.question: What do Electrical Engineering professionals do?
faqs.answer:
Electrical Engineering professionals are engineering jack of all trades, as they make use of their knowledge of Physics and Mathematics along with computer programming skills to develop intricate circuit systems. These circuit boards run electrical signals to and from electrical components to accomplish everything from a mundane computer startup to controlling absolute power and precision of a rocket going out of earth's atmosphere.

faqs.question: Which Medical fields offer the best work-life balance?
faqs.answer:
Some medical field which offe best work and life balance are shown below -
Dentistry (BDS & MDS) – Fixed clinic hours, fewer emergencies.
Pharmacy (BPharm & MPharm) – Less stress compared to hospital-based jobs.
Physiotherapy (BPT & MPT) – Flexible working hours, minimal emergency calls.
Public Health & Community Medicine – Focus on preventive healthcare rather than emergency treatments.
Clinical Research & Medical Writing – Research-based work with no direct patient responsibilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering in Collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It is quite satisfying because of faculty, curriculum, and tie-ups with multiple companies.

review_content.Placements: Actually, our college's first batch will pass out in 2026, so I can't say the exact packages yet. However, the university has multiple tie-ups with companies, so the chances of placement are high. Some students have also got paid internships. The top companies include IBM, Infosys, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The university infrastructure is quite satisfying. Multiple labs are available for different departments. The university also provides a library free of cost. Reading rooms are available 24/7 for students, but need permission from the HOD.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering in Collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering is collaborated with IBM in LTSU.

review_content.Placements: Currently, in our university, there are no placement records because this university was established on 09 December 2021, and no batch has been passed out. It has a good collaboration with the industry, like the tech giants. IBM is the anchor partner, and Tata Technology is also its industry partner. Several other companies like L&T Edutech, Efos, railway, etc., are collaborating with it.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many things, but the main focus is the IBM innovation center which is available 24x7, so we use the lab whenever we want. Hostel facilities are good, and it has full-time Wi-Fi access. The mess is clean and hygienic. It provides a decent quality of meals.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering(Core) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied because of the faculty members and really good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: 85% of students get placed in my course. The highest package offered in my course is 12 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA. The average package ranges from 5-6 LPA. Top recruiting company for my course is IBM. 75% of students got internships from my course in IBM company.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good and labs are also good. Classrooms are big enough for 65 students. The library is also equipped with nice books. The quality of the facilities in my hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is average. Medical facilities are available in the college. Sports and games are also held in college.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Finance and Capital Market - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Review of the emerging university Lamrin Tech Skills University.

review_content.Placements: About 60-70% of students get placed in our college. Students get placed based on their performance in college. The highest package is 20 LPA. The lowest package is 1.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies of our course are IBM, Tata, Infosys, etc. According to my research, 100% of students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has every facility like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. It is open for every course. Any student can get access easily. Facilities provided in our hostel are good but the mess food is not much good just eatable. Medical facilities are available. Sports events happen occasionally.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering(Core) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Lamrin Tech Skills University review.

review_content.Placements: They assure 100% placements. The college doesn't have a placement record yet but they guarantee 100% placements. IBM is the main force leading B.Tech students. They assure more than 8 LPA average package. They assure 1.5 years of internships and industry exposure. Many renowned personalities are called for lectures on various issues.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a good huge campus area. All the basic resources are provided like a gym, pool, etc. The campus infrastructure is just average. There is nothing special. Wi-Fi, labs, and a library are provided for students. Medical facilities are good. They have their own medical buses and infirmary rooms. Sports are really good here with boxing and taekwondo also included.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering(Core) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: University is about 100 acres of land with a huge ground.

review_content.Placements: University is new so there is no placement record. We are the first batch of this university. As they told us, they will provide placement with a minimum of 4 Lacs, and the course duration is 3 years with 1 year of on-job training. Top recruiters in this university are IBM, Microsoft, Effos, Capgemini, and many more.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are quite good or medium. Classrooms are huge. The library is huge, and books are always available. Labs are very good with good computer facilities, and in other labs for mechanical and electrical instruments, everything is working. Hostel facilities are very bad, sometimes there is a drinkable water problem, mess problems, and Wi-Fi is not working.

reviews.review_heading: It is quite satisfying because of faculty, curriculum, and tie-ups with multiple companies.
reviews.review_text: The university infrastructure is quite satisfying. Multiple labs are available for different departments. The university also provides a library free of cost. Reading rooms are available 24/7 for students, but need permission from the HOD.

reviews.review_heading: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering is collaborated with IBM in LTSU.
reviews.review_text: There are many things, but the main focus is the IBM innovation center which is available 24x7, so we use the lab whenever we want. Hostel facilities are good, and it has full-time Wi-Fi access. The mess is clean and hygienic. It provides a decent quality of meals.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the faculty members and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good and labs are also good. Classrooms are big enough for 65 students. The library is also equipped with nice books. The quality of the facilities in my hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is average. Medical facilities are available in the college. Sports and games are also held in college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the emerging university Lamrin Tech Skills University.
reviews.review_text: It has every facility like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. It is open for every course. Any student can get access easily. Facilities provided in our hostel are good but the mess food is not much good just eatable. Medical facilities are available. Sports events happen occasionally.

reviews.review_heading: Lamrin Tech Skills University review.
reviews.review_text: There is a good huge campus area. All the basic resources are provided like a gym, pool, etc. The campus infrastructure is just average. There is nothing special. Wi-Fi, labs, and a library are provided for students. Medical facilities are good. They have their own medical buses and infirmary rooms. Sports are really good here with boxing and taekwondo also included.

reviews.review_heading: University is about 100 acres of land with a huge ground.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are quite good or medium. Classrooms are huge. The library is huge, and books are always available. Labs are very good with good computer facilities, and in other labs for mechanical and electrical instruments, everything is working. Hostel facilities are very bad, sometimes there is a drinkable water problem, mess problems, and Wi-Fi is not working.

reviews.review_heading: Practical, industry-ready cybersecurity education with vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: Lamrin Tech Skills University offers a high-speed internet Wi-Fi network, advanced labs and classrooms equipped with teaching aids. The library has cybersecurity resources and the hostels provide essential services. The mess and canteen serve quality meals. Sports, medical facilities, and a gym enhance campus life, and the college has two large playgrounds where students can play and stay physically fit.

reviews.review_heading: First Tech Skill University in India with 100% placement guarantee.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was amazing and it has all facilities like high-speed wi-fi, a university providing a digital classroom and a very vast library with all types of books available. The university is providing all types of facilities to make a bright future for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning expression
reviews.review_text: Courses are delivered within well-equipped modern classrooms, state-of-the-art laboratories, high-speed WI-FI , and a comprehensive library. Hostels provide comfortable rooms with decent food, basic medical facilities, and sports amenities to further support student life in equilibrium.

reviews.review_heading: Lamrin a future to choose.
reviews.review_text: The hotels are not very lavish but above average where all basic amenities are provided. The campus is centralized wifi. Different room options such as Ac with common bathroom, Ac with bathroom and Non Ac room options are available as per the need of the student.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for payment after placement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and seminar facilities are all available. All classrooms have good lighting and fans that are always operational, so there are no issues with electricity. We can use unlimited Wi-Fi anytime, and the labs are open at all times, allowing us to study whenever we want.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a good campus life, quality education, good placement, and cultural activities.
reviews.review_text: Lamrin Tech Skills University is a skill-oriented university. It offers many skill-oriented courses, BTech in computer science, in which we have core or specializations like cyber security, data science, artificial intelligence & machine learning, and the internet of things. We have IBM with us as an anchor partner. We have many labs as an IBM lab, designed by IBM, a future skill lab with 24*7 lab service. Highly qualified professionals who teach us. In Lamrin Tech Skills University, there are d...

reviews.review_heading: LAMRIN "A Path to Enlightenment"
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is modern and well-maintained, which is suitable for a learning environment. The decorum of classrooms is also well-maintained to provide good learning. Hostels are good too, providing you with the facilities like Wi-Fi and regular sanitization.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent Faculty, Good and Healthy Food, Lots of Real-Life Project Work, Good Placements
reviews.review_text: Excellent quality. My course likely offers good Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, modern classrooms, and a resourceful library. Hostels provide basic facilities, with decent cleanliness. Mess food is usually average but repetitive. Medical facilities and sports amenities are generally available.

reviews.review_heading: A Best College to Pursue Your Life
reviews.review_text: Everything is too good. The hostel rooms are hygienic as well as spacious too. Washrooms are also clean. Pest control is sprayed every 15 days to control the pests. The mess is also spacious, and the quality of food is also nice. Labs are also open 24/7, which eases the work for students on projects.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: MSMIA is the best Ayurvedic college in Haryana. I am absolutely satisfied with the college.

review_content.Placements: The college provides an internship of one year, 6 months in the college hospital, and 6 months in any civil hospital in big cities. Interns are provided with a stipend of Rs. 10,000 per month for the whole year. Students are recruited as Ayurvedic medical officers in civil hospitals.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provides all the essential facilities of labs, classrooms, and the library to students. All the curriculum books are available in the library and students can issue them anytime they want to. The hostel provides 4 shared rooms, and the food is quite healthy. For medical facilities, the college has its own hospital and PG is also here. Sports like football, volleyball, and badminton are played in the sports complex of the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Supporting teacher and warden provide good facilities.

review_content.Placements: 100% placement occurs every year, and the highest package is 4-5 LPA. Companies like Mahindra, Airtel, and many more come to provide internships every semester. The company workshops are well-organized, and students manage all the work during the workshops. The teachers are very helpful.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is good infrastructure providing quality facilities, and all other basic needs are fulfilled. The campus is large, with a good environment and greenery all around. Good medical facilities are available, exams are held regularly, and results are declared quickly. Support for students is also excellent.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: MSM Institute of Ayurveda.

review_content.Placements: This is a decent medical course which offers vast career opportunities. Like you can start your own clinic, go into the research field, do jobs, run your own business, do post-graduation, etc. Top companies like Himalaya Drug Company, Patanjali, Aimil, etc., and even the Ministry of AYUSH.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college and facilities provided are just okay. Classrooms are fully smart. The library contains all books required. The hostel building is also just okay. For sports-loving students, a sports complex is there, and tournaments are also conducted.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The first women-only university in North India.

review_content.Placements: They say that the university has good placement, with an average of 3 LPA and a maximum salary package of 10 LPA for students. We will experience this later, but this is what we have heard from PAT alumni and our faculty staff. Additionally, there is a placement officer who conveyed the same information.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the overall university campus, including hostels and other areas, is very good. It's just that the campus is quite extensive, making it challenging to traverse from one place to another with a long-distance walk. Therefore, there should be some alternatives.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: My placements from BPMVS.

review_content.Placements: In our college, every year, 60–70% of students get placed through the on-campus placements drive. The placement cell of the college is very active and efficient for placements. The highest package for our course was 13 LPA. The average package at our college is 4-6 LPA. The top roles offered in the course are software developers, web developers, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: In terms of facilities, our college is top-notch. The infrastructure is good and well maintained. The college has necessary facilities like labs, library, canteens, hostels, medical equipment, sports equipments, Wi-Fi, etc. The computer labs have been developed and are working properly. The hostel rooms are furnished and big. The food in the mess is repetitive but good in taste.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with education system.

review_content.Placements: 100 percent placements is done in my college. The highest package is four to five LPA. Students do internships from Hindustan co-operative limited, etc. We start internship in the third year. We earn ten thousand per month. All courses are available in our college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our university provides all types of facilities like good classroom, labs and library. Hostels are well-maintained, providing good quality of food, and good services. Our university have a friendly environment and it focuses on student's health. Our university PGI is famous in India.

faqs.question: Q: Who is eligible for Lady Irwin College admission?

faqs.answer: No, Lady Irwin College admission to all the courses, i.e., undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, is entrance-based. While this DU-affiliated college accepts CUET UG exam for admission to its undergraduate courses, such as BEd, BSc admission to all the postgraduate courses is subject to the CUET- PG exam starting admission 2023. Lady Irwin College along with DU started accepting CUET UG starting 2022 and the CUET PG from 2023 session onward. Before this, admission to undergraduate was based on merit in Class 12 and PG admission was mostly subject to DUET exam previously conducted by DU.
faqs.question: Q: Can I get admission in Lady Irwin College without CUET?

faqs.answer: No, there is no offline method of application at Lady Irwin College. All the candidates must apply through the centralised entrance exam's official website, i.e., the official websites of CUET UG and CUET PG exam. content.Placements: There are more than 70 students enrolled in my course. As due to NEP, some of us will continue doing the 4th year, but some will only do 3rd year. reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Not an awesome college, but the cheapest private MBBS in Pune.

review_content.Placements: The placement scenario is non-existent. There are no PG seats in the college after MBBS completion. After the course MBBS, we can practice as a general doctor or try for PG seats, which have more scope as specialists are more in demand than Bachelor's degree graduates.
review_content.Infrastructure: The old government school has been converted into our current college campus, but the classrooms are nice. A new campus is being constructed. Low-quality food in a mess, and very limited options. No sports facility except table tennis. The library and labs are okay, not awesome, but they have the bare minimum.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Bad college life but it gets the job done.

review_content.Placements: No placement facility is present in the college. Students prepare for PG NEET after which I think we get placements. However, there is no PG seat in our college. There are no placements for now but hoping with time it will change and we get PG seats as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: Bathrooms of the college are very dirty. There is no hand sanitizer available in the washrooms. Even the dissection hall doesn't have a liquid handwash. Infrastructure is alright. College has a well-stocked library and online library facility as well. Mess food is okay. No canteen is present. No sports facilities or medical facilities exist. Hostel rooms are nice but the hostel is infested with rats and the cleaning staff doesn't come regularly. The college and hostel are not located in the same place.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Not a great college but the city makes it so worth it.

review_content.Placements: No batch has passed out yet from our college, so I can not elaborate on the current situation of placements. However, medical colleges do not have placements either way, so this question is not very relevant. The faculty teaches well enough that you can secure enough marks to get your desired PG.
review_content.Infrastructure: College has Wi-Fi, library, classrooms, labs, etc., that are well-built. College has overall good facilities and okayish infrastructure. Hostel has no mess and no canteen. There are no gym and medical facilities either. There are no provisions for sports or games. There are no facilities except for common washing machines, common geyser, and attached washrooms to each hostel room. There is a mice infestation problem.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: One of the cheapest private colleges in Pune.

review_content.Placements: Students have not passed out yet. The oldest batch is in 4th year right now as the college started four years ago. MBBS does not have a placement. But we can easily get a job after the course completion. Most students prepare for NEET, PG, or other foreign entrance exams. Students are trained sufficiently to tackle these challenges.
review_content.Infrastructure: College has Wi-Fi. Lecture halls have AC and smart boards. The labs are sufficient with all necessary equipment present. Each hostel room has a personal bathroom with cupboard, desk, and bed frame. Hostel facility is quite good for the price. The only drawback is that the hostel and college are very far. The boys' hostel is in Kharadi while the college is in Kasba Peth.

review_summary.college_name: Adichunchanagiri Institute of Medical Sciences Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and faculty.

content.Placements: There are 250 students in our batch, and we are the first batch of 250. The government fees are INR 1,73,000, private fees are INR 18,45,000, and management fees depend on the agreement, but are typically around INR 30 lakhs per year. After completing 4.5 years, all 250 students complete an internship.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel at our college has unlimited Wi-Fi. The college had well defined labs for all departments and the classrooms were comfortable with fans and air conditioning. The college also had a library that provided a good environment for studying. The only downside was the food in the hostel which did not include non-vegetarian options.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: An Honest Review by a Student at AIMS Bellur.

content.Placements: In contrast to most other private medical colleges throughout the country, our college pays during the internship, about 15,000 Rs. Internship is compulsory in order to get the license to practice and is 1 year long. Almost everyone writes NEET PG after the MBBS course. There are a decent number of patients as it is one of the biggest tertiary care hospitals in a radius of 50 km. The quality of education is good enough to get a good ranking in PG exams if you take studies seriously during the course. The pass-out percentage was 100% for the last batch. The college is NAAC A+ accredited.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Beautiful campus infrastructure .

content.Placements: The course requires a compulsory 1-year internship, which is completed in the hospital associated with the college. The internship includes 3 months of rural postings. The stipend received is 1.2 LPA. During the first year, students are posted to different departments for almost a month to enhance their skills and understanding of the subject.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good on campus, including a large college building, a multi-specialty hospital, a well-equipped library, multiple reading rooms, lounge areas for relatives, a temple, and guest rooms for parents when they come to stay. Also, there are separate hostels available for PG and UG students.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: AIMS - must go through this review as to why you might like this college!

content.Placements: This is a very reputed institution. After 4.5 years of MBBS course, we have to do one year of internship in this hospital, and the college also pays us a stipend. Throughout these 5.5 years, we get to see a lot of patients and can learn so many things under the expert doctors in their fields.
content.Infrastructure: The college has amazing infrastructure with well-maintained classrooms, washrooms, labs, and everything. We also have an amazing library with almost all the books required for the students and other journals too. The hostels are mostly 3-sharing with an attached bathroom and washrooms. They provide vegetarian food which is actually good and also give eggs twice a week, but they don't serve non-vegetarian food. The college supports students with sports too, apart from the academic front.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good with the infrastructure but poor campus life.

content.Placements: Our course has 100% placements. Internships are provided with a stipend of Rs.10,000 per month. After UG the salary starts at Rs.40,000 to 50,000 per month. After PG the salary starts at Rs.70,000 to 80,000 per month. Roles offered are junior resident, senior resident, and house surgeon in the beginning.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and hospitals are good with adequate patient input for the undergraduate level. Library is outstanding with books by different authors and contemporary studying space. Wi-Fi is fast and flawless. Hostel is the worst. Water and electricity are discontinuous. Mess provides veg with egg but it doesn't matter as the food is inedible.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Optometry (B.Optom) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty are helpful in everything. Hostel is excellent.

content.Placements: The percentage is almost 70 percent. Everything is under 50000. Everyone used to get a chance of internship after completing B. Pharma, B.Sc. nursing, B.Sc. mlt, B.Sc. optometry, and B.Sc. rit. They included a B.Sc. in physiotherapy and dialysis.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very good at in affordable price. Library is also there. Every book is available there. Wi-Fi used to be available in 3hostels. Practical used to be there 2times a day, food is available in the hostel. In a week there are 3 days nonveg. There is a canteen available at in affordable price.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: RIPANS - A memory to be remembered!

content.Placements: It is a central institute where admissions and hostel feel were very cheap. I finished my 4 years of B.Sc. Nursing with less than 2 lacs. The institution has well-learned and skilled teachers who guide us and provide us with knowledge. We were given enough freedom to express our opinions and we were encouraged to take part in various activities.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel has Wi-Fi in every block. The hostel mess was 1200. The mess was not that good, the taste was not good according to our taste buds but with 1200 per month it is not a bad bargain. The infrastructure of the college is very good with spacious classrooms, well-maintained labs, and the library has updated books.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Really satisfied, worth the money.

content.Placements: Around 45% were placed. The highest was 25 thousand, the lowest was 12 thousand and the average was 18 thousand. Aristo pharmaceuticals, sun pharma, Cipla, visited for placements. Everyone after completion of their course is given 3 months of industrial training in Hyderabad or any other pharmaceuticals.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the department is good. Like we are provided with classroom, laboratories for different subjects, machine room, animal house, library, computer room and also we have access to free Wi-Fi. The facilities in a hostel are very good and the quality of food available is good only.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Medical Radio Diagnosis and Imaging Technology (BMRIT) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The college environment is good, and the hostel cleanliness is very good.

content.Placements: There are 32 total seats in each course. I don't think salary packages are offered. There are no recruiting companies as we have to work in hospitals. Almost all students got internships from this course in every hospital, but we are not sure as it is corona time.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in college and in the hostel. Still, to get Wi-Fi, we need to go to the mess. Else we don't get Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not that tasty, and they only provide aloo fry and dal. On Saturday, they serve 2 chicken pieces, on Tuesday, they serve 1 fish fry, and on Thursday, they serve 1 egg. The food is not that tasty. Rest everything is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college. Students must consider it when taking admissions.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are of a high level. Classrooms and the library are available, and the library is open 24/7. The quality of facilities within the hostel is good. We get free electricity and water supply, and even the quality of food at the government hostel mess is of a good level. As a medical student of JMC Chandrapur, we also get free medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Admission worthy college.
reviews.review_text:
The new campus is very good, and classrooms are well furnished with nice equipment. 
And labs are nicely maintained with every piece of equipment 
The campus is very clean and nicely maintained and well guarded, and the food quality of the mess is good, and there are various other messes nearby in case you don't like the food.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college as it is nice to pursue UG courses.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are average just like any government institution. They provide hot water geysers and other facilities. The college building has a hospital named Harding Hospital. It is a government hospital in Chandrapur. The new campus building is under construction and will be completed by this year-end.

reviews.review_heading: College environment is not study-friendly.
reviews.review_text: There are good classrooms. A decent library with no Wi-Fi connection. There is a student cooperative mess operated by students only. Food quality is average. No canteen. You are the hospital's top priority in case of emergencies, so no need to worry about that. There are 2 major events in the year with sports games and cultural programs.

reviews.review_heading: It is a privilege to get admission in a government college.
reviews.review_text: In our college, we have decent hostels and mess. As the new campus is in process of construction, we are temporarily pursuing our education in the old institution in the city. Soon after 6 or 7 months or by the end of 2022, we will allotted the new campus in which there will be all modern facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It has good placements, a calm environment, amiable seniors, with a new campus emerging soon.
reviews.review_text: With the new emerging campus spanned in 100 acres, the college would be a true class apart in terms of infrastructure in competition to other Vidarbha colleges. Few parts of the current campus are converted to COVID hospitals in a surge of the 2nd wave but the college retains most of the essential parts like the library and a few departments. Our hostels were newly built in 2015 so they don't have many issues. Regular cleanliness is followed as well. The mess is under the satisfactory category a...

reviews.review_heading: It is an underrated government medical college with helpful seniors and a calm ambiance.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is rearranged post-Covid 2nd wave. Before that, the library, labs, and departments were converted to a hospital, but now, the library has been arranged as an auditorium with large space. are Students cooperative and mess is located in the boys' hostel. New college campus is being built with 100 acres area, that will surely provide everything but the old campus lacks.

reviews.review_heading: Budding college with bright minds. Minimal ragging and good clinical exposure.
reviews.review_text: During Covid 2nd wave some infrastructure was allocated for the Covid hospital but it's slowly being brought back to normal. The depts. are coming back and the infrastructure is being adjusted at suitable places. With the new college campus of 100 acre being under progress, it'll provide a great infrastructure to the future students. The quality of students' mess is good and satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Gmc Chandrapur college life.
reviews.review_text: At present lectures are being given at VRDL in old campus building but sooner or later they are going to shift us in new campus which is great and huge. The infrastructure is good. And facilities will be provided there like AC and cooler in classrooms and well designed lecture halls and beautiful hostels will be given.

reviews.review_heading: Government Medical College, Chandrapur. Good faculty ,nice campus and infrastructure
reviews.review_text: Nice campus . They've build a larger campus outside chandrapur . Which is about to start this year . Better hostel facilities and infrastructure is available. 24/7 electricity and water supply . Canteens for food are available. they're planning to improve this.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good, but the city is very expensive.
reviews.review_text: In this college, Wi-Fi was not enabled. The hostel was also not available. Our college will shift to a new campus by 2024. The new campus was good with all its facilities. It spread across 100 acres with approximately a cost of 900 crores.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Government Medical College, Chandrapur.
reviews.review_text: We do not have a proper campus yet but the new campus is very big and will be ready in about 2-3 years. Classrooms on this campus are not that big. Laboratories are good. No Wi-Fi, hostels are not that great, No library, quality of food is good enough.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Government Medical College, Chandrapur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well constructed and good. Hostels are also amazing. There is a water facility along with the hostel, and the college is nearby. Every facility from water to food is impressive. The well developed college was inaugurated in 2015. Sports opportunities are also available for interested ones. Medical professionals are always available.

review_summary.college_name: West Bengal State University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a really good college.

content.Placements: As this is mainly a B.Sc. And M.Sc. Degree college, proper campus placements are not available. However, some placement support is provided for Computer Science students. The college and the teachers are very good and helpful. Students can easily get internship opportunities from here. The expected salary package is around 3.5 to 5 LPA, even though there is no official placement system.
content.Infrastructure: Students can easily use the library. There are several labs where students can do practical work. The campus has a Wi-Fi facility. Digital boards are used in classrooms. There is a gym for students who like fitness. The canteen is very good. There is no hostel, so students stay in nearby messes or rented rooms.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the facility, however placements are very rare. The infrastructure is not lacking.

content.Placements: I have yet to pass out, but I can provide some details on alumni. From the CS department, a couple of guys got placed in TCS. The Maths department did not see many placements, mostly went for off campus or higher studies. Similar to the department of Physics, mostly off campus and higher studies.
content.Infrastructure: I do not have any use for a hostel, nor does my college provide hostels. I live not too far away, so traveling daily is practical. As for the college infrastructure, we have enough computers, good Wi-Fi, and good enough classrooms/lecture halls. Most of the apparatus is not digital in the Physics lab.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good and worthy college for both personal and academic growth.

content.Placements: Placements are average and mainly depend on students’ individual skills, performance, and internships. Around 50–60% of students secure placements and internships. The highest package offered is around 6–7 LPA, while the average is 3–4 LPA. Recruiting companies are popular, but as I am not aware of the companies, I cannot specify them.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is spacious, clean, and aesthetically pleasing. It has a pond-like area where students can get some fresh air and relax. Classrooms are good, but a few classrooms still need some improvement. Library is very nice. It is well-stocked with all types of books and journals. Free Wi-Fi is available, as well as a canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall faculty is awesome. Teachers have great experience in teaching.

content.Placements: There were no proper placements because its not an engineering college, but there were opportunities, sometimes companies visit for recruitment. There were notices on the college website from which you can see about the placement cell in our college and companies visiting for students with a Science background to hire if students were interested.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was overall good. Wi-Fi was available in every building. Students can use them. Wi-Fi speed was good. Library was also top class, you could borrow books from there for free, but for a limited period of time you could also renew them. We were in Chemistry department, so chemicals were plentiful, which helped in learning practicals very well. Labs were also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is not the place of study, it's about bonding, understanding, etc.

content.Placements: Normal placement companies like TCS. Chances are low, but placement is guaranteed. The teachers always help students with placement issues. Suggest how to be good at that. They will figure it out together for placement problems because they understand.
content.Infrastructure: Clean environment. Good Wi-Fi connection. Canteen food quality is average. Classrooms are well-maintained. Secure and smoke-free campus.
content.Faculty: Teaching quality is too good. The teachers always stand for students. Teachers are friendly with students. Even teachers play with students, like cricket, chess, etc. There is a yoga room for all of us, and it is well-maintained. It is clean also. I like my college.
